title: Shatter Gui
description: A modern UI overhaul that replaces vanilla menus
body:
# ShatterGUI — Client-Side UI Overhaul

ShatterGUI is a visual modification that replaces Minecraft's static grey menus with a dynamic, color-coded interface. It is designed to make menu navigation feel modern and responsive.

### Key Features:
* **Animated Backgrounds:** Replaces the standard dirt/panorama backgrounds with smooth, animated color gradients and an ambient particle system that persists across different menu screens.
* **Contextual Color Coding:** Each main menu section (Singleplayer, Multiplayer, Options) is assigned a unique color theme.
* **Enhanced Visual Feedback:**
    * **Buttons & Sliders:** Updated with neon outlines and smooth scaling animations when hovered.
    * **Click Effects:** Visual "sparks" appear when clicking elements, matching the current menu's color scheme.
